news.headline: Harrow's Top Two Drugs Alone Can Justify Its Current Valuation
news.summary: A bullish Seeking Alpha analysis argues that Harrow's two leading products alone are enough to justify the current market value near 52-week lows. It is a counterpoint to the skeptical October 23 piece ahead of the November 9 Q3 report.

news.headline: BlackRock updates its passive stake above 5% in Harrow (HROW)
news.summary: BlackRock filed an amended Schedule 13G reporting about 2.76M Harrow shares, roughly 7.4% of the company as of September 30, 2026. It is a passive position, but shows a large index/institutional holder stayed in through the selloff.

news.headline: Harrow To Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results After Market Close on November 9, 2026
news.summary: Harrow confirmed it will release Q3 2026 results after the market close on Monday, November 9, 2026, with a conference call expected the following morning. It will be the first quarter including a partial TYRVAYA contribution and the key test of the $350-365M full-year revenue guide.

news.headline: Harrow: The Second Half Has Too Much To Do
news.summary: A skeptical Seeking Alpha analysis argues the reiterated $350-365M 2026 revenue guidance leaves too much to deliver in the second half after a roughly $115M first half. It frames Q3 as the test of whether the VEVYE ramp and new products can close the gap.

news.headline: Harrow Stock Hits 52-Week Low at $28.51
news.summary: Harrow shares touched a 52-week low of $28.51, down about 38% year to date, as the Q2 earnings miss (adjusted loss of $0.46 vs. about $0.11 expected) weighs on sentiment. BTIG reiterated its Buy rating with a $63 target on October 7.

news.headline: Harrow has lost 32% in 3 months: why BTIG sees 106% upside from here
news.summary: BTIG reaffirmed its Buy rating with a $63 price target after the stock fell about 32% in three months. First-half revenue of $115M trails the plan, so Harrow needs $235-250M in 2H to hit its 2026 guidance.

news.headline: Harrow Closes Acquisition of TYRVAYA®
news.summary: Harrow closed its purchase of TYRVAYA (varenicline nasal spray for dry eye) from Viatris outside Japan for $30M cash plus up to $70M in sales milestones. The product is expected to contribute over $30M of revenue in 2027.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Company-confirmed on October 26: results after the close on November 9, conference call November 10 at 8:00 a.m. ET. Full-year guidance of $350-365M revenue and $80-100M adjusted EBITDA implies roughly $235-250M in 2H after a ~$115M first half, so Q3 needs a clear revenue step-up from VEVYE, BYOOVIZ (launched July) and the first TYRVAYA sales; watch whether guidance is held.

catalysts.label: QUELL (IHEEZO) topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline data from the prospective, randomized, multi-center QUELL trial of IHEEZO in patients receiving intravitreal injections are guided for Q4 2026 (per the Q2 report); positive data could support broader use of IHEEZO in the retina-injection setting.

catalysts.label: NATACYN topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline data from the investigator-initiated NATACYN study, which enrolled first patients in Q2 2026, are guided for Q4 2026.

catalysts.label: G-MELT (MELT-300) pre-NDA meeting with FDA
catalysts.detail: FDA granted a pre-NDA meeting, guided for early Q4 2026 on the Q2 call; no outcome disclosed yet. NDA submission targeted for 1H 2027.

catalysts.label: TRIESENCE Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Phase 3 in post-cataract inflammation and pain expected to fully enroll in 2026 with topline data in early 2027.

catalysts.label: OPUVIZ (aflibercept biosimilar) launch
catalysts.detail: Harrow expects to launch the OPUVIZ aflibercept biosimilar in 2027; TYRVAYA is also projected to add more than $30M of 2027 revenue.

catalysts.label: Launch of late-stage assets (G-MELT, YOCHIL)
catalysts.detail: Harrow intends to launch G-MELT and YOCHIL (formerly MELT-210) beginning in 2028.

pulse: Harrow trades around $29-30, near its October 9 52-week low of $28.51 (about 38% down year to date), with sentiment split between bullish voices (BTIG $63 Buy; an October 29 Seeking Alpha piece arguing the top two products alone justify the valuation) and skeptical commentary that the 2H guide is too back-end loaded; BlackRock's latest 13G/A shows a ~7.4% passive stake. The TYRVAYA acquisition closed October 5, and Q3 results are confirmed for November 9 after the close, where a strong ramp is needed to keep the $350-365M revenue guidance credible. Q4 also brings pending QUELL and NATACYN topline readouts and a G-MELT pre-NDA update.
